Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card itself is played?
Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when a card digivolves into this card itself?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't attack. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.
Card Q&A.q: This card attacks, and I use its [When Attacking] effect to play an [NSo] trait Digimon. If I then use this card's [Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve using 2 of my Digimon, can I use that Digimon to attack?

Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: I used this card's [Your Turn] effect to DNA digivolve, then I attacked using that Digimon. At such times, in what order can I activate that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect and [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Attacking] You may play 1 [NSo] trait Digimon card with a play cost of 3 or less from your trash without paying the cost.

[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [NSo] trait, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card with the [NSo] trait in the hand. Then, that DNA digivolved Digimon may attack.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon unsuspends.
